向存量提質。面對這一轉變所帶來的週期考驗，      has shifted decisively from greenfield expansion to enhancing the quality of

進運營與服務能力，為集團的長遠發展積蓄關鍵      financial discipline, prioritized cash flow management, continuously optimized
動能。                        our balance sheet, and honed our operational and service capabilities, thereby
                           building strong momentum for the Group’s sustainable, long-term growth.

了根本性優化。截至2025年底，集團有息負債降    fundamental optimization of our debt structure. As of year-end 2025, the Group’s

系及具體職責、風險管理整體流程、風險評估方   organizational system, detailed responsibility, overall procedures of risk

     意見                                                   Opinion
     本核數師（以下簡稱「我們」）已審計列載於第84頁                             We have audited the consolidated financial statements of Longfor Group
     至第279頁的龍湖集團控股有限公司（「貴公司」）                             Holdings Limited (the “Company”) and its subsidiaries (collectively referred to
     及其附屬公司（統稱「貴集團」）的綜合財務報表，                              as the “Group”) set out on pages 84 to 279, which comprise the consolidated
     此綜合財務報表包括於二零二五年十二月三十一                                statement of financial position as at December 31, 2025, and the consolidated
     日的綜合財務狀況報表及於截至該日止年度的綜                                statement of profit or loss and other comprehensive income, consolidated
     合損益及其他全面收益表、綜合權益變動表及綜                                statement of changes in equity and consolidated statement of cash flows for the
     合現金流量表，以及綜合財務報表附註，包括重                                year then ended, and notes to the consolidated financial statements, including
     大會計政策資料及其他解釋資料。                                      material accounting policy information and other explanatory information.

     我們認為，該等綜合財務報表已根據國際會計準                                In our opinion, the consolidated financial statements give a true and fair view
     則理事會（「國際會計準則理事會」）頒佈的《國際                              of the consolidated financial position of the Group as at December 31, 2025,
     財務報告準則會計準則》真實而中肯地反映貴集                                and of its consolidated financial performance and its consolidated cash flows for
     團於二零二五年十二月三十一日的綜合財務狀況                                the year then ended in accordance with IFRS Accounting Standards as issued by
     及截至該日止年度貴集團的綜合財務表現及其綜                                the International Accounting Standards Board (“IASB”) and have been properly
     合現金流量，並已遵照香港《公司條例》的披露規                               prepared in compliance with the disclosure requirements of the Hong Kong
     定妥為擬備。                                               Companies Ordinance.

            本集團長期業務目標過程中向其提供經濟                                recruiting additional employees and to provide them with economic

      52. 資本風險管理                                           52. CAPITAL RISK MANAGEMENT
            本集團管理資本以確保本集團的實體能持                                  The Group manages its capital to ensure that entities in the Group will
            續經營，同時透過優化債務及股本結餘為                                  be able to continue as a going concern while maximising the return to
            股東帶來最大回報。                                           shareholders through the optimisation of the debt and equity balance.

            本集團的資本結構包括債務淨額（包括                                   The capital structure of the Group consists of net debt, which includes,
            分別於附註30及31披露的借款及優先票                                 where appropriate, the borrowings and senior notes disclosed in notes
            據）、現金及現金等價物淨額以及本公司                                  30 and 31 respectively, net of cash and cash equivalents and equity
            擁有人應佔權益（包括已發行股本、儲備                                  attributable to owners of the Company, comprising issued share capital,
            及保留盈利）。                                             reserves and retained earnings.

            本公司董事定期審閱資本架構。作為該審                                  The directors of the Company review the capital structure on a regular
            閱的一部分，本公司董事考慮資本成本及                                  basis. As part of this review, the directors of the Company consider the
            與各類資本有關的風險，並採取適當措施                                  cost of capital and the risks associated with each class of capital, and take
            平衡整體資本架構。                                           appropriate actions to balance its overall capital structure.
